whitelistRule.enrollment: Explicit owner authorization + proof of target installation private-key possession; details Q04
whitelistRule.privacy: O13: protect unowned whitelist device information and enumeration/manage/use; public keys match policy, not raw device metadata.

levelRule.guarantee: AuthorizedScope(a,c) AND FreshAuthenticatedGrant(a,s) AND Effective(a,s,t,i) >= Required(c,t,i) => Executable(c)
levelRule.equality: CONFIRMED O13: equal level is permitted (>=)
levelRule.proposalEffective: min(proven_identity_ceiling, delegated_session_ceiling); no caller-package/signature/source penalty after valid authority proof. Missing required owner grant keeps active ceiling strictly below threshold.
levelRule.noHiddenDeny: Once sufficient effective authority exists within scope, no alternate transport/plugin-specific hardcoded veto may block the same capability.
levelRule.managementMonotonicity: Within same scope and session conditions, a higher authority includes all lower-authority operations and eligible management abilities.
levelRule.scopeVsLevel: Scope defines corresponding capability, with compiled whitelist ownership isolation; scale0..10/H5 adopted underO18

consentRule.exempt: Authenticated root targeting own OR any highest-admin whitelist; ordinary highest targeting own whitelist
consentRule.outsideWhitelist: Highest-risk actions require owner grant even for root; missing grant must be represented as insufficient effective authority, not disguised full authority.
consentRule.platformBoundary: No bypass of Android mandatory grants or remote site authentication/CAPTCHA/rights checks.
consentRule.sourceMismatchException: O16 four-step data protection: trust/force1 clicks, force2/force3 each fresh Android owner authentication unless truly no lock. No admin/whitelist exemption; business unlock only after confirmed erasure.

riskModel: ADB shell presence is not administrator identity
Plugin cannot select its own granted level
Whitelisting does not equal generating keys or proof of ownership
Shared/extractable private credential reuse is intentional per O14, not an automatic source-based denial
High-trust administrator addition must never be smuggled through plugin delegation/import or mutable capability thresholds
Root identity mismatch data guard is not administrator disable; exceptional owner-only flow is not bypassed by administrator whitelist

credentialRule.identity: Valid request signature maps to registered public key and its authorized level/scope; caller need not be an approved helper package.
credentialRule.replayProtection: Origin neutrality does not remove freshness, nonce, exact target/action binding or proof verification.
credentialRule.transport: Previously confirmed channel/intervention risk rules must be explicit required-level/session-grant rules, not covert source discrimination.
credentialRule.distributionRisk: A copied private key carries the same identity and authority by the chosen model; no secret-identity assumption for embedded credentials.

compiledAdministratorRule.highTrustSet: Immutable inside a built APK; additions require APK update, including when actor is root
compiledAdministratorRule.boundary: H5, static fields and revocation-only runtime changes defined in authority-scale.json
compiledAdministratorRule.disable: Any authorized strictly higher level may disable a strictly lower non-root identity; not limited to low principals or issuer subtree. Never reveal/borrow target whitelist through this operation. Root target is never disableable.
compiledAdministratorRule.root: Special role above all highest administrators, not peer highest
compiledAdministratorRule.enableOrDistribution: local signed journal +explicit compatible signed distribution; re-enable own issuer or strictly higher than disabling issuer; no offline instant-global revocation claim

numericAuthority: records/authority-scale.json and records/action-registry.json are normative engineering design; old group/example numbers illustrative only
